subject: Blocking-dep context-seed: auto-wire prerequisites as low-weight judged decaying context edges (gate-transparent)
description:
Make a task's DIRECT blocking deps (prerequisites) flow as retrieval context — automatically but precisely. Flat task, forks off main; SEQUENCE AFTER #13 lands (shares daemon.js regions).

WHERE IT GOES (root insight): suggest_links is a READ-ONLY ranker (suggestForTask, daemon.js:1257) — it does NOT create edges. The auto-CREATE happens in the autowire path. Seed in the unified ingestNode pipeline (daemon.js ~1416-1453) alongside autowireNewTaskWholeGraph, OR co-located with the native blocked-by edge seeding (daemon.js:150/168). Every edge funnels through overlayStore.addEdge (the single deduping writer) — use it.

SCOPE:
1. For each DIRECT blocking dep D of a new/adopted task A: seed a LOW-WEIGHT context edge D→A via overlayStore.addEdge(ov, D, A, null, 'context', LOW_WEIGHT, { by:'autowire-blockdep', judged:false }). Direction: prerequisite D provides context to A (D's summary flows into A). Bounded to 1 hop (anchored depth) — do NOT walk the transitive blocked-by tree.
2. GATE-TRANSPARENT pass-through: if D is a gate node (kind==='gate'), do NOT seed A↔gate (a gate carries no knowledge — ingestNode already skips embed+autowire for gates at daemon.js:1430). Instead pass THROUGH the gate to ITS blocking deps and seed those (skip contiguous gates; BOUNDED transit depth to avoid pathological chains). So 'A blocked_by gate blocked_by B' collapses to a single B→A context seed — the gate does not consume the hop.
3. judged:false → seeded edges enter the eager judge / Context Verdict Model (note-mqelk8e5ths) which keeps relevant deps + prunes operational-only ones; low weight so they never flood; they DECAY via the note-decay lane if never recalled-and-helpful.
4. Tests: blocking dep → context seed; gate in chain → seed skips gate, lands on real upstream; transitive tree NOT walked; idempotent (addEdge dedupes).

NON-GOALS: do not change suggest_links (it will auto-surface the new edges as suggest_kind:'context' since it reads the same edges); do not refactor the broader node lifecycle (task 28 owns that).

Commit onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.
